hooks.text: I started [business] with [small amount or resource]. Here's what month one looked like.
hooks.example: I started a sneaker cleaning business with $60 and a toothbrush.

hooks.text: [Time] ago I [old situation]. Now I [new situation].
hooks.example: Six months ago I couldn't edit a video. Now I edit for 4 podcasts.

hooks.text: The day I almost quit [thing], [what happened].
hooks.example: The day I almost quit making candles, a local shop asked to stock them.

hooks.text: My first customer came from [unexpected place].
